description: A deliberately bad draft: generic opener, banned phrase, vague CTA, no evidence references. Used as a fail fixture for the eval harness.

draft.subject: Quick question about Riverbend
draft.body: Dr. Vasquez — hope this finds you well. I wanted to reach out and circle back on cardiac care at Riverbend. We've helped leading institutions leverage synergies to move the needle on outcomes. Would you be open to a quick chat next week?
draft.cta: Open to a quick chat next week?

suggestions.fix: Open with the 9% cardiac case-volume decline (E1) and the throughput-ceiling quote (E3) instead of a generic greeting.
Cite at least E1 and E4 in the body and populate the references array.
Remove 'hope this finds you well', 'reach out', 'circle back', 'leverage', 'synergies', 'move the needle', 'quick chat', and 'quick question'.
Replace 'a quick chat' with a scoped ask like '20 minutes on Mercy's turnover data against your May schedule.'
Tighten subject to ≤ 8 words that names the gap, e.g. 'Riverbend's 9% case-volume gap.'
